scope: daily management scheduling only; application and controller remain unchanged

tests.includes: real owned process exit and compatible rollback; after observation, missing process does not restart or inspect source; signed notification, event auto-reset, hour boundary, stop and owner-hook preservation; external maintenance cancels owned checker and does not rearm a stale source timer

preserved_diagnostic_failure.reason: Probe started before new manager ready and read the previous stopped manager PID. Fixed diagnostic baseline to require a live pythonw manager with non-disabled status; retained original failed capture.

limits: Hourly expiry was verified with controlled clock tests, not by claiming a full hour of live observation.
The exact installed post-commit script was executed in the live check; the final real completion commit will use the registered hook.
Explicit login parameter is tested in isolation; its next natural login execution remains to observe.
Raw uncommitted edits do not authorize installation. Notifications are hints; original branch, clean tree, review, fixed checks, budget, STOP and compatibility gates remain.
recovery: Restore a matched management capsule/bootstrap/signed policy/startup shim; never restore business databases to undo this scheduling change.
